newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume firms, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume firms, prices mixed.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume rose to 1,941 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 1,825 kilos with most of the trade due to banks registering newly imported gold on the market to sell elsewhere, dealers said.
Gold closed at $357.00 an ounce compared to $355.00 at Tuesday's close, in line with higher levels in Europe, but eased to 1,395,100 lira per gram from the previous 1,400,600.
"Most of the day's trade was due to registering by banks, there may have been a couple of hundred kilos of normal trade outside that, but not more," one dealer said.
Exchange members which import gold, mostly banks, have to register imported gold by buying and selling on their own account before they can sell it to non-members outside the exchange.
The majority of the day's trade -- 1,141 kilos -- was traded in the morning session with 69.8 percent of trade conducted in dollar terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 0875.
